resources.string: Blocks adult websites, searches and apps, and protects PureGuard from being switched off.

PureGuard Screen Guard reads the address bar of browsers and the text on screen to detect adult content and close it. It also stops PureGuard\'s own protection from being disabled without the password. Nothing you see or type ever leaves your phone.
Disabling PureGuard requires the password. Open PureGuard to unlock.
